Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain for 3 days. Ski accident.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osseous contusion along the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and along the medial aspect of the patella consistent with a recent transient patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint hemarthrosis with intra-articular clot in the suprapatellar joint recess.  No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Complete tear of the MPFL from the adductor tubercle. High-grade sprain of the medial patellar retinaculum at the patellar attachment.
Patellofemoral tracking: Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Borderline patella alta. Oblique morphology of the trochlea. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 25 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of a recent transient lateral patellar dislocation with osseous contusions, large knee joint hemarthrosis, and injuries of the medial patellofemoral ligament and patellar retinacula, as described above.
2.	Anatomic morphology predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking, as described above.

This there is mild fraying of the weightbearing aspect of the lateral tibial condyle articular cartilage. The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is otherwise unremarkable. Conclusion: Grade II MCL sprain. No meniscal injury.

Trouvailles :

Il n’y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif ou de kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au niveau patellofémoral. Il y a amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle plus proéminent impliquant la facette latérale de la rotule avec fissure partielle de la facette médiale. Il y a aussi un léger amincissement du cartilage à la partie latérale de la trochlée du fémur. La rotule démontre une légère subluxation latérale. Il y a aussi œdème au niveau de la partie supéro-latérale du pad graisseux infra-rotulien entre le tendon rotulien et le condyle fémoral externe.

Le cartilage du compartiment interne et externe est préservé. Les ménisques sont sans particularité. Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

Œdème au niveau du pad graisseux suggestif d’un syndrome de friction (patellar tendon lateral femoral condyle friction syndrome). Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs au niveau patellofémoral. La combinaison des trouvailles est suggestif d’une biomécanique anormale au niveau patellofémoral.
